name: stress_long_career
description: Six jobs of ten bullets each: far more than a page holds, all of it in one section, every bullet long enough to wrap. The shape an integration test found and the golden set could not - every other fixture here is short enough that a systematic under-charge stays inside the drift budget.
headline: Backend Engineer
